modules.html:
Healthy smiles from the inside out

Your mouth doesn’t exist in isolation from the rest of your body. The materials in your fillings, the bacteria in your gums, and the way your jaw functions all influence your overall health, and as Montrose biological dentists, we take that connection seriously.
Patients travel to us from Southampton, Rice Village, Boulevard Oaks, and the other neighborhoods around our Montrose office for exactly this kind of care.

At My Dear Dentist, we take a whole-body approach to your care. That means choosing biocompatible materials, considering long-term health impact in every recommendation, and treating the cause of dental problems instead of just managing symptoms.
Biological dentistry that puts your whole health first

Biocompatible Materials

We use ceramic, composite, and metal-free options whenever possible — including BPA-free composites and zirconia restorations for patients with sensitivities or material concerns.

Safe Mercury Amalgam Removal

For patients with old amalgam fillings, we follow the SMART protocol to minimize mercury vapor exposure during removal, protecting both you and our team.

Whole-Body Wellness Connection

Chronic gum inflammation, jaw tension, and airway issues all affect health far beyond the mouth. We consider those connections when planning your care.

Conservative Treatment Philosophy

We do what’s needed, nothing more. That often means smaller, more targeted treatment than a typical dental practice would recommend.

Personalized Approach

We take time to understand your health history, sensitivities, and goals. Your treatment is designed for you, not pulled from a template.

Care for people who expect more

You might be looking for a biological dentist in Montrose if you:

  • Want metal-free dental work
  • Have had reactions to dental materials in the past
  • Live with autoimmune conditions or chemical sensitivities
  • Want your old mercury fillings removed safely
  • Believe oral health affects whole-body health and want a dentist who agrees

Feel good about every visit

At My Dear Dentist, we believe dentistry is about more than healthy teeth; it’s about helping you feel your best, inside and out. As a family-owned Montrose practice, we deliver advanced, whole-body dental care with a personal touch. You’ll always be treated like family here — with honesty, warmth, and genuine care.
Biological dentistry FAQs

items.title: What is a Montrose biological dentist?
items.html: A Montrose biological dentist focuses on dental care that supports both your oral health and whole-body wellness. This approach considers how dental materials, inflammation, bacteria, and treatments may affect the rest of the body, while prioritizing biocompatible materials and minimally invasive techniques.

items.title: How is biological dentistry different from traditional dentistry?
items.html: Biological dentistry takes a more whole-body approach to care. While traditional dentistry focuses primarily on treating teeth and gums, a Montrose biological dentist also considers how dental treatments, materials, and oral health conditions may impact your overall wellness.

items.title: Does a biological dentist use metal-free materials?
items.html: Many biological dentists offer metal-free or low-toxicity dental materials whenever possible. At our Montrose dental office, we may recommend options like BPA-free composite fillings or zirconia restorations for patients with sensitivities, allergies, or concerns about metal in their dental work.

items.title: Can a Montrose biological dentist remove mercury amalgam fillings safely?
items.html: Yes. A Montrose biological dentist may use a specialized safety protocol, such as the SMART protocol, when removing old mercury amalgam fillings. This process is designed to reduce mercury vapor exposure and help protect patients, the dental team, and the treatment environment.

items.title: Who should consider seeing a biological dentist in Montrose?
items.html: You may benefit from seeing a biological dentist in Montrose if you are interested in biocompatible materials, metal-free restorations, safer amalgam removal, or a more wellness-centered approach to dental care. Biological dentistry may also appeal to patients with material sensitivities or those who prefer minimally invasive treatment whenever possible.

items.title: What services does a Montrose biological dentist offer?
items.html: A Montrose biological dentist may offer many general and restorative dental services through a whole-body wellness lens. This can include biocompatible fillings, ceramic or zirconia restorations, mercury amalgam removal, preventive care, gum health support, and personalized treatment planning based on your health needs and preferences.
